candidates.excerpt: The Bharat Rashtra Samithi has accused the Congress government in Telangana of discriminating against Scheduled Caste representatives, citing the case of Kashamma, sarpanch of Jajala village, who has opposed alleged illegal sand mining in Chief Minister Revanth Reddy’s home mandal.

candidates.excerpt: He was known to be Congress leader Rahul Gandhi’s favourite but after the party’s defeat in the recent Delhi University Students’ Union election, Kanhaiya Kumar is no longer the blue-eyed boy that he once was. As AICC-in charge of the National Students Union of India, Mr Kumar is facing flak as he was responsible for the selection of candidates for the DUSU polls
